protocol.selection: Use calibration only: maximize minimum of planner/coder valid counts (9 each), then their sum; tie-break lower median input+output tokens across all 18 known-usage responses, then expanded_caps. Freeze selection before independent acceptance.
protocol.acceptance: Only the selected configuration is evaluated on 18 NEW planner and 18 NEW coder fixtures (3 templates x 6 repeats). Each must have at least 17 complete schema-valid outputs; coder must also execute in the bounded interpreter. No reselection after acceptance.
protocol.end_to_end: 6 NEW synthetic execution contexts. Actual valid planner output is passed to coder. An invalid planner skips coder and is a failed pair. At least 5/6 pairs valid. Run diagnostics even if acceptance fails; S1 stays gated.
protocol.complete_output: finish_reason=stop and no unclosed thought; final JSON outside any closed thought meets schema. Also report JSON/schema validity separately from completion.
protocol.planner_schema: name,intent,formula nonempty strings; tags 1-2 from actual task vocabulary; identical to discovery.planner_prompt request
protocol.coder_execution: Identical bounded Program interpreter and feature vocabulary as TSP search; 4 non-instance feature dictionaries including zero/late-tour inputs; never Python exec/eval
protocol.prompt_policy: Use unchanged discovery.SYSTEM/planner_prompt/coder_prompt. Only output caps differ across configurations. Synthetic histories are explicitly recorded in fixtures, never reported as measured scores.
protocol.failures: Malformed model outputs consume slots without retries. Any provider/indeterminate failure halts the batch; missing slots stay unstarted. Durable responses are recovered without retransmission. No success replacement.
protocol.continuation: Run S1 only if both independent acceptance gates and E2E >=5/6 pass. Passing engineering gates is not evidence for search superiority.
protocol.r1_provenance: r1 aborted after 1 request (781 known tokens). Not pooled with r2; retain its source, manifest and response. r2 also corrects impossible 17/18 gate, synthetic prompt mismatch, absent end-to-end plan handoff, and unsafe exec-based validator before any new calls.
protocol.independence: No task-instance coordinates or hidden-test scores used. Calibration, acceptance and E2E fixtures frozen separately; synthetic feedback only.
